items.snippet: My guest today is Zach Reitano, the co-founder and CEO of Ro, the country’s leading provider of GLP-1s. In four years, Ro has grown from a $250 million run rate to over $3 billion, with fewer people than it had in 2021. The heart of our conversation is what he sees as the central flaw in American healthcare, which is that the patient is not the customer.
